description: Reactive terminal UI (TUI) framework for .NET with custom ANSI rendering, MVVM architecture, source-generated reactive properties, and ASP.NET Core-style routing.
Offline inspection of names, descriptions and input schemas for Microsoft.Extensions.AI function tools.
Detects breaking changes in source-generated .NET structured logging contracts. Captures and diffs LoggerMessage event IDs, names, levels, templates, and structured properties locally and in CI.
A .NET port of Presidio: local, in-process PII and PHI detection and de-identification for text, logs and structured data, with a bundled offline NER model. No Python, service or network needed.
Image, PDF and DICOM redaction for Deidentify.NET, the .NET port of Presidio: local OCR, flattened output, and DICOM metadata plus burned-in pixel redaction.

Returns SGuard guard failures from ASP.NET Core as 400 Bad Request validation problem details (RFC 9457), keyed by the failing member and with messages that don't expose values or code. Works with minimal APIs and controllers through the built-in exception handler. Targets net8.0/net9.0/net10.0.
Lightweight task-like asynchronous primitives and timer scheduling for .NET.
Log-structured merge tree implementation of the BTDB key value database stored directly in object storage.
Azure Blob Storage adapter for BTDB.LSM.

Cross-platform (Windows, Linux) process monitoring: select processes by PID, name, path, service or ancestry, sample chosen metrics at a fixed rate, and receive per-period min / mean / median / max / sd / rms (optionally with the raw samples) plus start and exit events.

SQLite storage for Xeniorn.ProcessTools: an EF Core DbContext designed to be inherited and extended, entities for tracked processes and per-period metric summaries (numeric columns plus packed raw samples), and a tracking sink that writes to it.
